scientific_integrity: The full-scope claim follows from a closed-form matrix response and strictly log-concave objective; the separate finite numerical checker verifies representative trajectories and asymptotics but is not a substitute for proof. scientific_limitations: Single well-mixed air compartment and one linear surface reservoir; initial pulse entirely gaseous; fixed positive rates; exactly one instantaneous fraction-removal event; unchanged chemistry; fixed finite cumulative-air objective. No emissions caused by cleaning, nonlinear saturation, parameter uncertainty, health-risk calibration, or field validation. The originality comparison is best-knowledge and not exhaustive.
title: A unique spectral cleaning clock for a two-compartment indoor pollutant reservoir
